item.title: AI Roundup: FDA clears autonomous blood draw robot, UHS acquires Talkspace, Databricks hits $190B valuation, AI-designed glioblastoma vaccine advances
item.description: FDA clears Aletta, the first autonomous robotic blood draw device. Blood draws are common, and this task has historically required skilled personnel.

item.title: Molecularly guided therapy may improve outcomes in patients with unfavourable cancer of unknown primary compared with standard chemotherapy
item.description: 1. Molecularly guided therapy (MGT) was linked to significantly improved progression-free survival (PFS) versus standard platinum-based chemotherapy.

item.title: Aletta brings autonomous robotics into routine blood collection
item.description: 1. Aletta is the first FDA-authorized standalone robotic device to draw blood from a patient's arm without operator intervention, moving toward routine use.

item.title: Higher coffee intake is associated with lower visceral fat despite similar body mass index
item.description: 1. A Finnish cohort study of 2,264 adults found that higher coffee intake was associated with lower total and visceral fat and greater skeletal muscle mass.
